title: Physical Constraints on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena
doc_notes: This document is a scientific paper by Abraham Loeb and Sean M. Kirkpatrick discussing physical constraints on UAP and interstellar objects, published by the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO).
